subject: parser: support new sql syntax to distribute table regions (#60027)
summary: Reviewed the parser-only changes: new tokens/keywords (DISTRIBUTE/DISTRIBUTION/RULE), new grammar for `DISTRIBUTE TABLE ... RULE = <ident> ENGINE = <ident>` and `SHOW DISTRIBUTION JOB(S)`, plus AST/Restore updates and added parser tests. No Blocker/High issues found in parsing correctness, compatibility, or restore behavior; later upstream history mainly extends this feature set (e.g. TIMEOUT/CANCEL DISTRIBUTION JOB) without indicating a fix for a prior Blocker/High parser bug.
